description: vanilla is a minimalist, high-performance HTTP server written in V: multi-threaded, non-blocking io_uring I/O, lock-free, copy-free, SO_REUSEPORT. This entry is the vanilla-epoll entry's async handler verbatim, running on the io_uring async runtime (enghitalo/vanilla#99): DB queries park on the PG socket via a oneshot IORING_OP_POLL_ADD and resume on the ring — never blocking the worker. JSON is built in a single allocation with precomputed prefixes (no per-request reflection); json-comp gzips on Accept-Encoding; json-tls serves /json over HTTP/1.1 + TLS 1.3 on :8081 via the lib's epoll backend (the io_uring backend has no TLS) with kTLS record offload where present; static-tls serves the 20 /static files on :8081 through vanilla's static_assets (br/gzip negotiation; snapshots re-checked against the disk, so a replaced file is served at once), sending bodies of 16 KiB or more with sendfile(2) over kTLS; fortunes renders the DB rows + a runtime row with HTML escaping; async-db/crud/fortunes use the native async pg_async driver with per-worker pipelined pools. Built with the default GC on pinned V master (built from source). async parks each /delay/{ms} on a one-shot timerfd from a per-worker free-list and answers only once it reports an expiration; 8gbit echoes the POST body on the :8081 TLS listener (Content-Length or chunked, per-worker dechunk buffer); production-stack's /api cache-aside (X-Cache MISS/HIT, 1 s items / 30 s users TTL, invalidated on write) runs in-process — no Redis required. One worker per CPU of the container's cpuset.
